name: Calculator Hide Files
tagline: A working calculator that secretly hides your files
description:
Calculator Hide Files looks and works like an ordinary calculator, but it's secretly a vault for your private photos, videos, audio, and notes. Enter the right code and it unlocks your hidden files instead of just doing math.

Everything you hide is protected with AES encryption, so even if someone finds the app, your files stay unreadable without the right access.
